# PortfolioIcon

<!-- description:start -->
Displays a colored icon for a Tracker portfolio entity. The icon color is deterministically derived from the `portfolioId`, so the same portfolio always renders the same color across sessions and environments.
<!-- description:end -->

## Usage

```tsx
import {PortfolioIcon} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

<PortfolioIcon portfolioId="portfolio-abc" />
```

## Component props

<!-- props:start -->
```ts
{
    /**
     * Portfolio ID used to generate a deterministic color.
     * Typically the string entity ID returned by the Tracker API.
     */
    portfolioId: string;

    /**
     * Additional CSS class applied to the root element.
     */
    className?: string;

    /**
     * Entity type label. Defaults to "portfolio".
     */
    type?: string;

    /**
     * Size of the SVG icon inside the container in pixels.
     * @default 16
     */
    size?: number;

    /**
     * Size of the icon container (the colored square) in pixels.
     * @default 24
     */
    refugeSize?: number;

    /**
     * Whether to render a colored background behind the icon.
     * `PortfolioIcon` defaults this to `false`; `EntityIcon`'s own default is `true`.
     * @default false
     */
    withBackground?: boolean;

    /**
     * Alpha (opacity) of the icon foreground color, in the range 0–1.
     * @default 1
     */
    colorAlpha?: number;

    /**
     * Border radius variant of the icon container.
     * @default 'm'
     */
    radius?: 'm' | 'l';

    /**
     * Alpha (opacity) of the icon foreground color.
     * @default 1
     */
    colorAlpha?: number;
}
```
<!-- props:end -->

---

## Examples

### Default

```tsx
import {PortfolioIcon} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

<PortfolioIcon portfolioId="portfolio-abc" />
```

### With background

```tsx
<PortfolioIcon portfolioId="portfolio-abc" withBackground />
```

### Custom size

```tsx
<PortfolioIcon portfolioId="portfolio-abc" size={20} refugeSize={32} />
```

### Alongside portfolio name

```tsx
import {PortfolioIcon} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

export const PortfolioLabel = ({portfolio}: {portfolio: {id: string; name: string}}) => (
    <div style={{display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8}}>
        <PortfolioIcon portfolioId={portfolio.id} />
        <span>{portfolio.name}</span>
    </div>
);
```

### Multiple portfolios (each gets a unique color)

```tsx
const portfolios = [
    {id: 'port-1', name: 'Platform'},
    {id: 'port-2', name: 'Growth'},
    {id: 'port-3', name: 'Infrastructure'},
];

portfolios.map((p) => (
    <div key={p.id} style={{display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8}}>
        <PortfolioIcon portfolioId={p.id} />
        <span>{p.name}</span>
    </div>
));
```

---

## Notes

- Unlike [`ProjectIcon`](../ProjectIcon/README.md) and [`GoalIcon`](../GoalIcon/README.md), `PortfolioIcon` uses the **string `id`** (not `shortId`) for color generation.
- `withBackground` defaults to `false` for portfolios (vs `true` for projects). Pass `withBackground` explicitly if you want the colored square background.
- To render the correct icon for an arbitrary meta entity type, use [`MetaEntityIcon`](../MetaEntityIcon/README.md) instead.
